description: This file contains SQL commands to set up and configure the 'profiles' table within a PostgreSQL database for a backend system. It creates extensions, defines table schema, indexes, security policies, and includes procedural code to conditionally create policies based on their existence.

methods.name: do $$ begin ... end $$
methods.description: Procedural code block to check for existing policies and create them if absent.

calls: create extension if not exists pgcrypto
create table if not exists public.profiles
create index if not exists idx_profiles_id
alter table public.profiles enable row level security
